summary: Comprehensive testing of Notification System - All 11 backend API tests passed, all frontend UI tests passed. The notification bell, dropdown, settings panel, and preferences are working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Notification system is fully implemented and working. All APIs tested: GET /api/notifications/summary, GET /api/notifications, GET /api/notifications/preferences, PUT /api/notifications/preferences, PATCH /api/notifications/{id}/read, PATCH /api/notifications/mark-all-read, POST /api/notifications/dismiss/{id}, POST /api/notifications/generate-task-notifications

notification_bell_display.details: Notification bell displays in dashboard header at position x=1860. Bell icon shows BellRing animation when there are unread notifications.

notification_badge_count.details: Badge shows unread count (e.g., '1'). Badge is red with white text, positioned at top-right of bell icon.

notification_dropdown_open.details: Clicking notification bell opens dropdown panel. Dropdown shows 'Notifications' header with subtitle showing task counts (e.g., '1 due today').

notification_dropdown_content.details: Dropdown shows notification items with type icons (Clock for due today, AlertTriangle for overdue), titles, messages, and timestamps. Shows 'All caught up!' when no pending notifications.

notification_settings_gear.details: Settings gear icon in dropdown header opens inline settings panel when clicked.

notification_settings_panel.details: Settings panel shows 7 checkboxes: In-app notifications, Weekly email digest (with day selector), Push notifications, and 4 notification type toggles (Overdue, Due today, Due soon, Assigned to me).

notification_settings_toggle.details: Toggling checkboxes updates preferences via PUT /api/notifications/preferences. Toast message 'Notification preferences updated' confirms save.

notification_dropdown_close.details: Dropdown closes when clicking outside the dropdown area.

backend_notification_summary.details: GET /api/notifications/summary returns unread_count, overdue_tasks, due_today_tasks, due_soon_tasks, total_action_items.

backend_notification_list.details: GET /api/notifications returns list of notifications with _id, type, title, message, read, dismissed, created_at fields.

backend_notification_preferences.details: GET/PUT /api/notifications/preferences works correctly. Preferences include in_app_enabled, email_digest_enabled, push_enabled, and notification type toggles.

backend_mark_read.details: PATCH /api/notifications/{id}/read marks individual notification as read. PATCH /api/notifications/mark-all-read marks all as read.

backend_dismiss.details: POST /api/notifications/dismiss/{id} dismisses notification (hides from feed but keeps in history).

backend_generate_notifications.details: POST /api/notifications/generate-task-notifications generates notifications for tasks due today, due soon, and overdue.

backend_unauthorized_access.details: All notification endpoints correctly reject unauthorized requests with 401/403 status codes.

notes: The notification system is fully functional. The bell icon animates (BellRing) when there are unread notifications. The dropdown shows task summary in subtitle. Settings panel allows toggling all notification preferences. All backend APIs are working correctly with proper authentication.
